clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs make close() settle the pending JSON-response-mode POST instead of leaving it hanging, but they disagree on how: #2692 resolves it with a JSON-RPC error object (code -32000, 'Connection closed'), consistent with the -32000 error-code convention already used elsewhere in this file (e.g. the DELETE/session-not-found handlers), and its description explicitly handles the case where a batched POST shares one stream across multiple request ids, grouping outstanding ids per stream so an id that already has a real response isn't overwritten. #2600 instead answers the same pending request with a raw HTTP 404 'Session not found', a different and here-inapplicable error condition, and its description does not mention the batched-request-per-stream case. clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs make close() settle the pending JSON-response-mode POST instead of leaving it hanging, but they disagree on how: #2692 resolves it with a JSON-RPC error object (code -32000, 'Connection closed'), consistent with the -32000 error-code convention already used elsewhere in this file (e.g. the DELETE/session-not-found handlers), and its description explicitly handles the case where a batched POST shares one stream across multiple request ids, grouping outstanding ids per stream so an id that already has a real response isn't overwritten. #2600 instead answers the same pending request with a raw HTTP 404 'Session not found', a different and here-inapplicable error condition, and its description does not mention the batched-request-per-stream case. Note #2600 also clears `_requestToStreamMapping` on close() (a separate correlation-leak fix not mentioned in #2692's description), so that part should be ported into whichever PR is kept.
